messages:
Evan (PM): quick sync — need final decision on structured function-output launch gates. specifically: 1) least-privilege output (strip fields) 2) validation levels (strict/lenient) 3) fallback behavior on schema mismatch. can we lock PRD scope by EOD?
Maya (prodops): question — do we have any paying customers blocking on strict validation right now?
Rahul (eng): yes, one large healthcare customer wants strict + cert. most others prefer lenient fallback.
Priya (SWE): propose two-mode: `strict` rejects + logs, `lenient` transforms best-effort + tags response with `__validation_warnings`. fallback route to smaller compatible model if validation fails.
Zoe (security): concern: function args could leak PII. recommend: redaction hooks, an allowlist for fields passed to functions, and audit log entries for all function calls. also require encryption at rest for logs.
Jonas (platform): rollout idea: canary 10% behind a feature flag, monitor validation_fail_rate and latency p99. if failures >0.5% for 5m, auto-fallback to lenient.
Lucia (design): UX note: show an inline non-technical banner "Output didn't match expected shape" with clear actions: retry / view raw / contact support. add a subtle icon for degraded output.
Sam (SRE): metrics we need: validation_rejects_total, validation_latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), fallback_triggered_total, function_call_args_redacted_total. SLO: validation adds <10ms p95.
Evan (PM): acceptance criteria draft: - strict mode: enforce schema, respond 422 + structured error - lenient mode: return best-effort output + `__validation_warnings` array - fallback: route to compatible model and surface metric - security: redaction & allowlist + audit logs retention policy - rollout: feature flag + 10% canary + automated rollback rule.
Rahul (eng): important edge cases: streaming responses with mid-stream schema drift; partial tool failures (one tool succeeds, another fails); concurrent KV cache divergence. suggestions: for streaming, validate chunk boundaries and attach per-chunk validation tags; for partial tools, include per-tool status in the response body.
Priya (SWE): sample per-tool status payload (for PRD and SDK):
```json
{"tools": [{"name": "search", "status": "ok"}, {"name": "db_write", "status": "failed", "error": "constraint_violation"}], "__validation_warnings": ["missing field: user.address.zip"]}
```
Zoe (security): add retention policy: audit logs retained 90 days, encrypted, with process for data subject requests. also recommend a default allowlist deny posture and org-level overrides for regulated customers.
Maya (prodops): customer comms: if strict is opt-in we need a migration guide + sample transforms + CLI tools to test their payloads. timeline impact?
Evan (PM): timeline proposal: PRD draft by tomorrow noon, engineering spike 5d, canary in ~3 weeks. decision needed now: make strict mode opt-in or strict-by-default. vote with thumbs: +1 opt-in, -1 strict-by-default.
Jonas (platform): +1 opt-in.
Rahul (eng): +1 opt-in.
Zoe (security): -1 — prefer strict-by-default for regulated orgs. can we make strict default for orgs with compliance flags?
Evan (PM): compromise: opt-in strict by default for general orgs, but allow org-level policy to enforce strict for regulated customers (configurable). action items: 1) Evan to update PRD with acceptance criteria and timeline 2) Rahul + Priya to implement validation library API + perf targets 3) Zoe to draft redaction & allowlist policy 4) Lucia to mock UX error states and microcopy 5) Maya to prepare customer comms + migration guide. owners/due dates added in PRD.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window created for canary test on 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC :rocket:
Evan (PM): thanks — if no objections I'll lock opt-in strict & move forward. :thumbsup:
